summary: A 1914 crow's nest, a 1915 42-ft platform and a 1934 50-ft L-4 tower for the Clearwater Timber Protective Association in Clearwater County; both sources list it as gone.

facts.design: 50-ft L-4 tower, after a 1914 crow's nest and log cabin and a 1915 42-ft platform
facts.status_note: Both lookout sources list it as gone.

visit.trail_note: Idaho Fire Lookouts tags the site Drive-Up.

evidence.supports: 1914 crow's nest and log cabin; 1915 42-ft platform; 1934 50-ft L-4 tower; two patrols east; gone
evidence.quote: 1914: crows nest, log cabin. 1915: 42' platform. 1934: 50' L-4 tower. 2 patrols east. Gone.

evidence.supports: two patrol points to the east
evidence.quote: Two patrol points to the east

evidence.supports: listed under Clearwater Timber Protective Association at township 38N, range 7E, section 07
FFLA list marks the tower gone

notes_for_editor: No source dates the removal, so no fate event is recorded. The sources spell the name Elk West (firelookout.com, Idaho Fire Lookouts) and Elk Mountain (West) (FFLA list). The 1915 cabin in Section 11 of T42N R4E on the Clearwater County listing belongs to another site and was not used. The Drive-Up tag comes from the listing and describes the old site, not present conditions. The brief had no events; 1914, 1915 and 1934 build events are added from both lookout pages. No source describes the site today.
